title: Uniform pullback and ordered shifted Tate tensor bounds
statement: In the setting of [def-sp-twisted-pullback-tower-domain-data], but without G, an adjunction or an orientation, let K belong to the constructible finite-Tor tower subcategory and suppose every level has Tor interval [a,z], a<=z. For the bounds predicate of [lem-sp-tower-chart-admissibility], B has cohomological and Tor intervals [a,z]. The degree-d finite Tate line is constructible and locally free of rank one [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module], and is isomorphic to the coefficient unit when d=0. P=B tensor orderedLine(d), and also orderedLine(d) tensor B, have both intervals [a-2d,z-2d]; orderedLine(d) has both intervals [-2d,-2d]. Use [lem-sf-pullback-tor-amplitude], [lem-pur-twist-sheaf-locally-free], [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf], [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude], [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels] and [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers] for the finite-level meanings.

proof.text: Smooth pullback preserves bounded constructibility and the given Tor interval at every finite quotient. Test against the coefficient unit for the cohomological interval. Finiteness over the field supplies the Noetherian hypotheses.

The finite Tate line and all nonnegative tensor powers are locally free of rank one with finite constant local models; the zeroth power is the unit. Tensoring with the line is exact and preserves the constructible stratification.

Induct on the ordered line construction. Exact tensor, associativity and the shift by 2 at each step subtract 2 from both endpoints. The same local computation with the line on the left gives the reverse tensor bounds. Level comparison identifies the actual evaluations. The result is independent of n, and no orientation or exceptional adjoint is used.

theorem pullback_ordered_tate_bounds
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (b : SpTowerShriek.Base l E) (o : SpTowerShriek.Operations l E b)
    (q : SpTowerCalculus.Coordinates l E b)
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (X Y : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of D.k)))
    [IsSeparated X.hom] [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] [QuasiCompact X.hom]
    [IsSeparated Y.hom] [LocallyOfFiniteType Y.hom] [QuasiCompact Y.hom]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsSeparated f.left] (d : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f.left]
    (w : SpChartAdmissibility.Twists l E X.left)
    (K : SpTowerCalculus.C l E b q Y.left) (a z : ℤ) (haz : a ≤ z)
    (hTor : ∀ n : ℕ, HasProEtaleTorAmplitude Y.left (SpTowerShriek.R l E n)
      ((SpTowerShriek.Ev l E Y.left n).obj
        ((SpTowerGamma.realization l E b q Y.left).obj K)) a z) :
    SpChartAdmissibility.bounds l E X.left (B l E b o q f.left K) a z a z ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ,
      IsConstructibleProEtaleModuleSheaf X.left (SpTowerShriek.R l E n)
        (spEllTwistLine l E X.left n (d : ℤ)) ∧
      (spEllTwistLine l E X.left n (d : ℤ)).IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank 1 ∧
      (d = 0 → Nonempty (spEllTwistLine l E X.left n (d : ℤ) ≅
        SheafOfModules.unit ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X.left)
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj
            (SpTowerShriek.B l E X.left n))))) ∧
    SpChartAdmissibility.bounds l E X.left (P l E b o q f.left w d K)
      (a - 2 * d) (z - 2 * d) (a - 2 * d) (z - 2 * d) ∧
    SpChartAdmissibility.bounds l E X.left (SpTowerGamma.orderedLine l E b X.left w d)
      (-2 * d) (-2 * d) (-2 * d) (-2 * d) ∧
    SpChartAdmissibility.bounds l E X.left
      ((SpTowerShriek.tensor l E b X.left).obj
        (SpTowerGamma.orderedLine l E b X.left w d, B l E b o q f.left K))
      (a - 2 * d) (z - 2 * d) (a - 2 * d) (z - 2 * d)
